title: Same-frame ESC + left-press-only shares the Cancel-latch hazard but gets no Press_Anchor
detail: Same-frame ESC + plain left press re-anchors identically (inp.press = left_press) yet emits no Press_Anchor; only the chord branches do. Either an executor gate protects this leg or ESC+left-click is broken and unpinned.
recommended_fix: Confirm an executor gate covers the ESC + left-press-only path, or emit Press_Anchor there too; add a pin mirroring the chord scenarios (ESC + left press + non-moved release).

title: sel_pipe 'none' sentinel changed 0→-1 but reshaped scenario 20 omits the field (defaults 0)
evidence:
-	sel_pipe: i64, // preset selection (0 = none selected)
+	sel_pipe: i64, // preset selection (-1 = none selected)
		name = "input_parity_esc_release_place",
		tier = tier_std,
		mouse = frames(
		name = "input_parity_esc_deselect_chord",
		tier = tier_std,
		sel_pipe = -1, // no preset selection
detail: The struct contract now reads -1 = none and scenarios 21/22 set -1, but esc_release_place — reshaped in the same diff — carries no sel_pipe field between tier and mouse, defaulting to 0: pipe 0 preselected under the new contract, or a mixed old/new sentinel.
recommended_fix: Set sel_pipe = -1 in every scenario literal meaning 'no preset selection', including esc_release_place; audit the preselect consumption site for how 0 and -1 are interpreted.

title: popover rect computed twice per press in popover_click
detail: popover_demolish_hit builds a popover rect and popover_click's node/pipe branches rebuild the same rect afterward. Deterministic, so no drift — but the shared hit-test still leaves two constructions of the same geometry to maintain.
recommended_fix: Have popover_demolish_hit return the hit popover rect, or factor one popover-rect helper, so the demolish button leg and the panel swallow share a single computation.

title: Placement-cancel chord leg: Press_Anchor moved before Right_Click with no new pin
location: app/input/mouse.odin:hunk @@ -168,6 +168,16 @@ (placing branch) vs removed r2 block
evidence:
+			if press_anchor {
+				append(out, Intent(Press_Anchor{}))
+			}
			append(out, Intent(Right_Click{pos = right_press}))
-			// ONLY when a Cancel is actually in the queue: an unconditional
-			// Press_Anchor after Right_Click would undo right_click_select's
-			// was_dragging latch (Perkins r2 warning).
detail: r2 emitted Press_Anchor after Right_Click in the placement-cancel leg; r3 emits it before (Cancel→Press_Anchor→Right_Click). The was_dragging survivor flips, yet both new pins cover only the ESC legs — the reordered placement-cancel leg is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add or confirm a pin for chord-while-placing (no ESC) ending in a non-moved release after an interrupted drag, asserting the intended was_dragging outcome; the r2 warning shows this ordering is load-bearing.
